packet.claim: The recovery kernel's cell grammar and scoring behavior are inconsistent with the documented recover_json_object rule: several inputs that should be scoreable or unchanged are reported as INVALID_INSTANTIATION or moved.
packet.execution_evidence: The provided test campaign results show 'executed': 'INVALID_INSTANTIATION' for the reproducer and similar inputs, and 'executed': 'moved' with 'as_expected': false for the fence[ A B ] case.
packet.expected: According to recover_json_object, every top-level balanced object in the text is a candidate; the last object inside a code fence when any fence holds one, else the last top-level object, is scored. Inputs with a fenced JSON object followed by prose or another object should recover the last scoreable object, and adding an object after a fence should move the recovered object to the new last object.
packet.observed: The executed results show INVALID_INSTANTIATION for many rewrites that add an object after a fenced object or prose, and one case where adding an object after a fence with two objects moved the recovered object from the second to the third, contrary to the expected unchanged behavior.
packet.scope: All inputs to the recovery kernel that contain a fenced JSON object followed by additional top-level objects or prose, and rewrites that add objects after such fences.
packet.source_basis: recover_json_object: 'Every top-level balanced object in the text is a candidate... The object scored is the last one inside a code fence when any fence holds one, else the last top-level object in the text... A candidate that parses as strict JSON, or as JSON with repeated keys resolved last-wins, is scoreable.'
packet.uncertainty: The exact cell grammar rules are not fully specified in the provided documentation, so some INVALID_INSTANTIATION results may be due to grammar constraints not described here. The expected behavior for the fence[ A B ] case is inferred from the rule that the last object inside a code fence is scored, which should remain the second object when a third is added outside the fence.
